text:
maria: FYI opened PR 5824 to clarify long-context behavior for Nebula3b model cards and add a tiny SDK snippet showing rolling-window generation + embed-sharding. Would love a quick docs + eng-ml pass before merge.
ryan: link?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5824 — main changes are: clarify sequence limits (explicitly call out max_context vs effective long-window), add a 3-line SDK sample for shard-based embeddings, and fix two bad links to old benchmark CSV.
jin: skimmed — overall looks good. two nits: 1) the snippet uses `max_tokens` (SDK2 naming) — we prefer `max_new_tokens` in our Python examples. 2) bench table label is "tokens/sec" but bench output uses "tokens/s"; make it consistent.
eva: also please call out quantized-variant fallback behavior under Compatibility. I almost used the quantized variant and didn't realize CPU fallback might change perf numbers.
maria: good catches. i'll switch snippet to max_new_tokens and normalize the bench label. for fallback i'll add a one-line pointer under Compatibility to the runtime-fallback playbook (short link).
sam: do we have an SDK3 embed-shard snippet canonical pattern? PR currently shows a naive `shard_count=2` example that might encourage sharding without noting embedding order/merge caveats.
maria: i can replace with a small idiomatic SDK3 example — something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# rolling-window generation for long contexts
resp = c.generate(model="nebula3b", prompt=long_doc, max_new_tokens=256, rolling_window=1024)
# embed sharding: create shards and merge by averaging
shards = [long_doc[i:i+1000] for i in range(0, len(long_doc), 1000)]
embs = [c.embed(model="nebula3b-embed", text=s) for s in shards]
merged = np.mean(embs, axis=0)
```
I'll add a short note about ordering/merge semantics.
jin: prefer to show usage of the batching helper too (small one-liner) so folks don't shard manually if they don't need to.
maria: good point — will add a one-liner link to the batching helper in SDK3.
docs-bot: preview site updated for PR 5824 — https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-5824
ryan: LGTM apart from jin's batching helper add. tiny comment on wording.
eva: left 2 inline comments about fallback phrasing. overall +1 :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — plan: make these edits today, run the preview check, then merge after CI. i'll also add redirects for the two broken benchmark links so older docs still resolve.
deploy-bot: merge scheduled after CI passes — queue id 78922
maria: merging when green. will tag eng-ml and runtime on the roll-forward message for visibility.
